name: kaon
title: Kaon Router
description: Kaon Router spend against your daily budget, in the menu bar and as a usage breakdown
author: dofy

commands.name: balance
commands.title: Kaon Balance
commands.description: Show today's Kaon Router spend in the menu bar

commands.name: usage
commands.title: Kaon Usage
commands.description: Budget, rate limits and the usage breakdown by model, key and provider

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: Automation Token
preferences.description: kaon_pat_* token with the usage:read scope. Leave empty to read Token File Path instead.

preferences.name: tokenPath
preferences.title: Token File Path
preferences.description: File holding the kaon_pat_* token, used when Automation Token is empty. Keep it at mode 600.

preferences.name: baseURL
preferences.title: Admin API Base URL
preferences.description: Kaon Admin API root, without a trailing slash.

preferences.name: titleFormat
preferences.title: Menu Bar Title
preferences.description: What the menu bar shows. The dropdown always carries the full numbers.

preferences.name: warnRatio
preferences.title: Warning Threshold
preferences.description: Fraction of the daily budget that tints the menu bar icon yellow. Range: 0–1.

preferences.name: critRatio
preferences.title: Critical Threshold
preferences.description: Fraction of the daily budget that tints the menu bar icon red. Range: 0–1.

preferences.name: summaryRange
preferences.title: Breakdown Range
preferences.description: Range for the usage breakdown. 24h is broken upstream and returns one-minute buckets.

preferences.name: expiryWarnDays
preferences.title: Token Expiry Warning
preferences.description: Warn once the automation token is within this many days of expiry. Range: 0–365.

preferences.name: requestTimeoutSeconds
preferences.title: Request Timeout (Seconds)
preferences.description: Per-request timeout against the Admin API. Range: 1–120.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
